tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a listing from the system with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a message from the system confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a message from the system confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

214	    parser.add_argument(

216	    )

221	        "own seed; training's --seed is fixed because it names the cache.",
222	    )

225	    parser.add_argument("--priority", default="high")

233	    steps = recipe["steps"] if args.steps is None else args.steps

235	    name = args.name or f"{args.recipe}-s{seed}" + ("" if args.steps is None else f"-{steps}st")

243	    except (OSError, ValueError, LookupError):

253	        "--master_addr=$BEAKER_LEADER_REPLICA_HOSTNAME", "--master_port=29400", "--nproc_per_node=8",
254	        "open_instruct/olmo_core_finetune.py",
255	        # mason joins the command for `bash -c` without quoting plain arguments.
256	        "--model_name_or_path", shlex.quote(args.checkpoint or recipe["checkpoint"]),
257	        *recipe["train_args"],
258	        "--max_train_steps", str(steps),
259	        # A permanent checkpoint half way through, plus the final one.
260	        "--checkpointing_steps", str(half),
261	        # Ephemeral saves for resuming; OLMo-core needs them strictly more frequent than the permanent ones.
262	        "--ephemeral_save_interval", str(SAVE_EVERY if half > SAVE_EVERY else 0),
263	        "--data_loader_seed", str(seed), "--run_name", name, "--output_dir", output_dir,
264	    ]  # fmt: skip
265	    mason = [
266	        sys.executable, "mason.py",
267	        "--cluster", recipe["cluster"], "--workspace", args.workspace, "--budget", "ai2/oe-other",
268	        "--image", recipe["image"], "--pure_docker_mode", "--num_nodes", str(nodes), "--gpus", "8",
269	        "--priority", args.priority, "--min_runtime", recipe["min_runtime"], "--auto_resume",
270	        "--timeout", recipe["timeout"],
271	        "--extra_weka_buckets", "olmo-3p5-checkpoints", "olmo-3p5-post-checkpoints",
272	        "--env", "OLMO_SHARED_FS=1", "--env", f"EXPECTED_NUMPY_CACHE={recipe['cache']}",
273	        *[arg for env in recipe.get("env", []) for arg in ("--env", env)],
274	        "--task_name", name,
275	        "--description", f"SFT recipe {args.recipe}: {name}, {steps} steps, seed {seed}",
276	        "--",
277	        *train,
278	    ]  # fmt: skip
279	    print(f"Output: {output_dir}", flush=True)
280	    if args.dry_run:
281	        print(shlex.join(mason))

283	    subprocess.run(mason, cwd=REPO_ROOT, check=True)

17	def plan(monkeypatch, capsys, *args):
18	    """Run sft.py --dry_run without Beaker and return the mason command it prints, split into arguments."""
19	
20	    def no_beaker(*_args, **_kwargs):
21	        raise OSError("no beaker in tests")
22	
23	    monkeypatch.setattr(sft.subprocess, "run", no_beaker)
24	    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["sft.py", *args, "--dry_run"])
25	    sft.main()
26	    lines = capsys.readouterr().out.strip().splitlines()
27	    assert lines[0].startswith("Output: /weka/oe-adapt-default/allennlp/deletable_checkpoint/<user>/sft/")

36	def test_recipe_plans_a_launch(monkeypatch, capsys, name):

38	    cmd = plan(monkeypatch, capsys, "--recipe", name)
39	    assert value(cmd, "--image") == recipe["image"]
40	    assert value(cmd, "--num_nodes") == str(recipe["nodes"])
41	    assert value(cmd, "--cluster") == recipe["cluster"]
42	    assert value(cmd, "--max_train_steps") == str(recipe["steps"])

46	    for env in recipe.get("env", []):

ARG CUDA_VERSION=12
# "" or "-moe" (CUDA 13 only): the -moe image adds transformer-engine for MoE v2 models; see below.
ARG IMAGE_VARIANT=""
FROM nvidia/cuda:12.8.1-devel-ubuntu22.04 AS cuda12
FROM nvidia/cuda:13.0.3-devel-ubuntu22.04 AS cuda13
FROM nvidia/cuda:13.3.1-cudnn-devel-ubuntu22.04 AS cuda13-moe
# torch is built with CUDA 13.0; without this DeepSpeed refuses to JIT-build its ops (CPU Adam) against 13.3.
ENV DS_SKIP_CUDA_CHECK=1
FROM cuda${CUDA_VERSION}${IMAGE_VARIANT}

ARG CUDA_VERSION
ARG IMAGE_VARIANT

ARG DEBIAN_FRONTEND="noninteractive"
ENV TZ="America/Los_Angeles" \
    LANG=en_US.UTF-8

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    curl \
    wget \
    git \
    make \
    sudo \
    nginx \
    && apt-get autoremove -y \
    && mkdir -p /etc/nginx/conf.d \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# This ensures the dynamic linker (or NVIDIA's container runtime, I'm not sure)
# puts the right NVIDIA things in the right place (that THOR requires).
ENV NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES=graphics,utility,compute

# Install DOCA OFED user-space drivers
# See https://docs.nvidia.com/doca/sdk/doca-host+installation+and+upgrade/index.html
# doca-ofed-userspace ver 2.10.0 depends on mft=4.31.0-149
ENV MFT_VER=4.31.0-149
RUN wget https://www.mellanox.com/downloads/MFT/mft-${MFT_VER}-x86_64-deb.tgz && \
    tar -xzf mft-${MFT_VER}-x86_64-deb.tgz && \
    mft-${MFT_VER}-x86_64-deb/install.sh --without-kernel && \
    rm mft-${MFT_VER}-x86_64-deb.tgz

ENV DOFED_VER=2.10.0 \
    OS_VER=ubuntu2204
RUN wget https://www.mellanox.com/downloads/DOCA/DOCA_v${DOFED_VER}/host/doca-host_${DOFED_VER}-093000-25.01-${OS_VER}_amd64.deb && \
    dpkg -i doca-host_${DOFED_VER}-093000-25.01-${OS_VER}_amd64.deb && \
    apt-get update && apt-get -y install --no-install-recommends doca-ofed-userspace && \
    apt-get autoremove -y && \
    rm doca-host_${DOFED_VER}-093000-25.01-${OS_VER}_amd64.deb

# Install Google Cloud CLI
RUN echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/cloud.google.gpg] http://packages.cloud.google.com/apt cloud-sdk main" \
        | tee -a /etc/apt/sources.list.d/google-cloud-sdk.list \
    && curl https://packages.cloud.google.com/apt/doc/apt-key.gpg \
        | apt-key --keyring /usr/share/keyrings/cloud.google.gpg add - \
    && apt-get update -y && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends google-cloud-cli \
    && apt-get autoremove -y \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
# Taken from https://beaker.org/api/v3/release (add | jq -r '.version' if you want it programmatically).
ENV BEAKER_VERSION=v1.5.235
RUN curl --silent \
    --connect-timeout 5 \
    --max-time 180 \
    --retry 5 \
    --retry-delay 0 \
    --retry-max-time 600 \
    --output beaker.tar.gz \
    "https://beaker.org/api/v3/release/cli?os=linux&arch=amd64&version=${BEAKER_VERSION}" \
    && tar -zxf beaker.tar.gz -C /usr/local/bin/ ./beaker \
    && rm beaker.tar.gz

COPY --from=ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:0.8.6 /uv /uvx /bin/

WORKDIR /stage/

ENV UV_CACHE_DIR=/root/.cache/uv \
    HF_HUB_ENABLE_HF_TRANSFER=1 \
    UV_COMPILE_BYTECODE=0 \
    SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION_FOR_OPEN_INSTRUCT=0.0.0+docker

# Install dependencies
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=${UV_CACHE_DIR} \
    --mount=type=bind,source=uv.lock,target=uv.lock \
    --mount=type=bind,source=pyproject.toml,target=pyproject.toml \
    uv run --frozen --no-default-groups --group dev --group cuda${CUDA_VERSION} \
        python -m nltk.downloader punkt punkt_tab words

# MoE v2 models (OLMoDDPModel, e.g. Olmo 3.5 Small) need transformer-engine's token-permutation kernels
# (olmo_core/nn/moe/utils.py). Only the -moe image gets it, so the default images are unchanged:
# - TE 2.16.1's prebuilt cu13 library calls cublasLtGroupedMatrixLayoutInit_internal, which torch's
#   bundled cuBLAS (nvidia-cublas 13.1.0.3) does not export. torch's bundled libcublas/libcublasLt are
#   pointed at the base image's newer system copies; LD_LIBRARY_PATH cannot do it, because torch loads
#   the bundled path. That changes cuBLAS for everything in the image, hence a separate variant.
# - The torch bindings compile against the venv's torch (--no-build-isolation, build tools first) and
#   the venv's cuDNN headers. TE_MAX_JOBS=2 fits Docker Desktop's 8 GiB VM; raise it on a Linux host.

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

if [[ "${1:-}" == "--miles" ]]; then
  shift
  if [[ "${1:-}" == "--cuda-version" || "${1:-}" == --cuda-version=* ]]; then
    echo "Error: --miles cannot be combined with --cuda-version; MILES uses its own pinned runtime." >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  exec bash scripts/miles/build_and_launch.sh "$@"
fi

cuda_version=12
if [[ "${1:-}" == "--cuda-version" ]]; then
  if [[ $# -lt 2 ]]; then
    echo "Error: --cuda-version requires 12 or 13."
    exit 1
  fi
  cuda_version="${2:-}"
  shift 2
elif [[ "${1:-}" == --cuda-version=* ]]; then
  cuda_version="${1#*=}"
  shift
fi

if [[ "${1:-}" == "--miles" ]]; then
  echo "Error: --miles cannot be combined with --cuda-version; MILES uses its own pinned runtime." >&2
  exit 1
fi

if [[ "$cuda_version" != "12" && "$cuda_version" != "13" ]]; then
  echo "Error: --cuda-version must be 12 or 13."
  exit 1
fi

# --moe: the CUDA 13 image plus transformer-engine, which MoE v2 (OLMoDDPModel) models need (see Dockerfile).
image_variant=""
if [[ "${1:-}" == "--moe" ]]; then
  if [[ "$cuda_version" != "13" ]]; then
    echo "Error: --moe needs --cuda-version 13 (only the CUDA 13 image has a transformer-engine variant)." >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  image_variant="-moe"
  shift
fi

if [[ $# -eq 0 ]]; then
  echo "Usage: $0 [--cuda-version 12|13 [--moe]] SCRIPT [SCRIPT_ARGS...]"
  echo "       $0 --miles CONFIG [--set KEY=VALUE ...]"
  exit 1
fi

# 1) Verify we're inside a Git repo
if ! git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Error: This directory is not a Git repository."
  exit 1
fi

# 2) Fail if there are any uncommitted or untracked changes
#    (staged, unstaged, or untracked files)
if [[ -n "$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null)" ]]; then
  echo "Error: Uncommitted changes detected. Please commit or stash before running."
  echo "------- git status (short) -------"
  git status --short
  exit 1
fi

git_hash=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
git_branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)
# Sanitize the branch name to remove invalid characters for Beaker names
# Beaker names can only contain letters, numbers, -_. and may not start with -
sanitized_branch=$(echo "$git_branch" | sed 's/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/-/g' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | sed 's/^-//')
image_name=open-instruct-integration-test-${sanitized_branch}-cuda${cuda_version}${image_variant}

beaker_user=$(beaker account whoami --format json | jq -r '.[0].name')

existing_image_desc=$(beaker image get "$beaker_user/$image_name" --format json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.[0].description // ""' || echo "")

if [[ -n "$existing_image_desc" ]] && [[ "$existing_image_desc" == *"$git_hash"* ]]; then
  echo "Beaker image already exists for commit $git_hash, skipping Docker build and upload."
else
  echo "Creating CUDA $cuda_version${image_variant} beaker image for commit $git_hash..."
  CACHE_REPO="${DOCKER_CACHE_REPO:-ghcr.io/allenai/open-instruct:buildcache}"

  # Try to build with cache push first, fall back to cache-from only if push fails
  if docker buildx build --platform=linux/amd64 \
    --build-arg GIT_COMMIT="$git_hash" \
    --build-arg GIT_BRANCH="$git_branch" \
    --build-arg CUDA_VERSION="$cuda_version" \
    --build-arg IMAGE_VARIANT="$image_variant" \
    --cache-from "type=registry,ref=$CACHE_REPO" \
    --cache-to "type=registry,ref=$CACHE_REPO,mode=max" \
    --load \
    . -t "$image_name"; then
    echo "Build succeeded with cache push."
  else
    echo "Warning: Build with cache push failed (likely due to permissions). Retrying without cache push..."
    docker buildx build --platform=linux/amd64 \
      --build-arg GIT_COMMIT="$git_hash" \
      --build-arg GIT_BRANCH="$git_branch" \
      --build-arg CUDA_VERSION="$cuda_version" \
      --build-arg IMAGE_VARIANT="$image_variant" \
      --cache-from "type=registry,ref=$CACHE_REPO" \
      --load \
      . -t "$image_name"
  fi

  beaker image rename "$beaker_user/$image_name" "" || echo "Image not found, skipping rename."

  beaker image create "$image_name" -n "$image_name" -w "ai2/$beaker_user" \
    --description "Git commit: $git_hash; CUDA: $cuda_version${image_variant:+; variant: moe}"
fi

# Ensure uv is installed and sync dependencies before running the script
if ! command -v uv &> /dev/null; then
    echo "Installing uv..."
    curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
    export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"
fi

# Install Python dependencies
echo "Installing dependencies with uv..."
uv sync

# Run the provided script with the image name and all remaining arguments
script="$1"
shift
bash "$script" "$beaker_user/$image_name" "$@"

1	# Running SFT: a known-good starting point
2	
3	## Olmo 3.5: one command
4	
5	```bash
6	uv run python scripts/train/sft.py --recipe c12r
7	```
8	
9	`c12r` is the current Olmo 3.5 small recipe: C12 SFT on base B1
10	(`olmo35-small-mm-ckpt1-64k` step 20000) plus 10% long-context replay, peak LR 2e-4,
11	half an epoch (18,410 steps). It runs on 2×8 B300 on `ai2/holmes` at `high` and
12	takes about 9 h. It is the `b1-c12r-gpu` arm of H182, an internal Ai2 post-training
13	experiment (H-numbers here are its internal tracking IDs).
14	
15	- **Another base:** `--checkpoint <dir> --name <run>`. The checkpoint must be an
16	  OLMo-core DCP (the `model_and_optim` directory); HF checkpoints are not accepted.
17	- **Output:** `/weka/oe-adapt-default/allennlp/deletable_checkpoint/<you>/sft/<name>`,
18	  with a permanent checkpoint half way through and one at the end. It is a deletable
19	  scratch location: copy out anything you want to keep. The directory has no timestamp,
20	  so running the same command again resumes from its latest checkpoint. Beaker
21	  requeues the job after a preemption on its own.
22	- **Other flags:** `--seed` (data order), `--steps`, `--workspace`, `--priority`, and
23	  `--dry_run`, which prints the mason command without launching it.
24	- **Nothing to build:** each recipe pins the Beaker image it runs with, so the
25	  training code comes from that image, not from your checkout.
26	
27	### Olmo 3.5 Small (A4B)
28	
29	```bash
30	uv run python scripts/train/sft.py --recipe a4b
31	```
32	
33	`a4b` is `c12r` (same data, replay, seeds and 18,410 steps) on the Olmo 3.5 Small
34	hero (the A4B MoE) at its 4T decay endpoint (`olmo35-4b-active-4t-decay159k-causal`
35	step 162974), peak LR 7.3e-5, with experts sharded 8 ways inside each node and the
36	fused linear+CE loss. It runs on 2×8 B300 on `ai2/holmes`; about 7.4 s/step and 38 h are
37	estimates from a 300-step run of the same flags (with the nested checkpoints off, per #2291)
38	on the earlier image `01M6XV36`. The pinned image passed a 40-step smoke test (8.20 s/step
39	over steps 10–40, matching CE); no full training run has used this recipe yet. It pins its
40	own image because main's image has no transformer-engine, which the A4B MoE needs; that
41	image also holds the model config (`scripts/c12/a4b_sft_config.json`), with whole-block
42	recompute and the nested attention/MoE checkpoints off. All CLI flags documented above for
43	`c12r` apply.
44	
45	Exporting these checkpoints to HF for evaluation is not yet one command; it follows
46	ledger hypothesis H167's G4 step.
47	
48	## Olmo 3 7B dense (one node)
49	
50	**One epoch of Dolci-Instruct-SFT, one 8×H100 node.**
51	
52	Measured cost and outcome: ~1.5 h tokenization (CPU, 0 GPUs) + ~9.5 h training
53	(~77 GPU-hours) + ~15 min per checkpoint to evaluate. IFBench +6.7 and GSM8K +1.8
54	over the base model, which lands 2.4 points under the released
55	`Olmo-3-7B-Instruct-SFT` on IFBench.
56	
57	The recipe is [`scripts/train/debug/oc_sft_olmo3_7b_1node.sh`](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/main/scripts/train/debug/oc_sft_olmo3_7b_1node.sh).
58	Read its header before editing it: several flags look wrong and are not, and the
59	reasons are recorded there rather than repeated here. For a flag-by-flag reference
60	see [Supervised finetuning](finetune.md).
61	
62	### Example runs
63	
64	| Report | What it is |
65	|---|---|
66	| [Olmo 3 7B SFT pipeline validation](https://wandb.ai/ai2-llm/open_instruct_internal/reports/Olmo-3-7B-SFT-pipeline-validation-and-eval-results--VmlldzoxNzcwOTIyMg) | This recipe, verbatim. [Beaker](https://beaker.org/ex/01KZHT32T30M2VHCWKRJS1G9P7) · [W&B run](https://wandb.ai/ai2-llm/open_instruct_internal/runs/ed453531) |
67	| [Olmo-Hybrid-7B SFT](https://wandb.ai/ai2-llm/open_instruct_internal/reports/Olmo-Hybrid-7B-SFT-through-open-instruct-it-works-on-Blackwell--VmlldzoxNzcyMjMzOQ) | The same recipe pointed at the hybrid base model. [Beaker](https://beaker.org/ex/01M013HTEWJYVHAKPHHJ762YJW) |
68	
69	### Before you start
70	
71	- Ai2-internal only: Beaker access, Docker, and `beaker account whoami` working.
72	- `build_image_and_launch.sh` refuses to run with uncommitted changes, so commit first.
73	- Steps 1–3 run from an open-instruct checkout; step 4 runs from an
74	  [olmo-eval](https://github.com/allenai/olmo-eval) checkout (`uv sync --frozen`).
75	
76	### 1. Tokenize (CPU job, ~1.5 h)
77	
78	Training hard-fails if the pre-tokenized cache is missing, so tokenization is a
79	separate job:
80	
81	```bash
82	./scripts/train/build_image_and_launch.sh scripts/train/debug/oc_sft_olmo3_7b_1node.sh tokenize
83	```
84	
85	The cache key hashes the tokenizer config, mixer, transform functions,
86	`max_seq_length` and seed. Both jobs read those from shared variables at the top of
87	the script so they cannot drift — if you change one, change it once, and re-tokenize.
88	Any divergence produces a different key and training fails as though tokenization
89	never ran. Never symlink a cache built at a shorter `max_seq_length` into a longer
90	run's cache path: its rows were truncated at tokenize time and training doesn't
91	check, so the run trains on short data while its config and logs report the long
92	length.
93	
94	Wait for this job to reach exit 0 before launching step 2.
95	
96	### 2. Train (1×8 H100, ~9.5 h)
97	
98	```bash
99	./scripts/train/build_image_and_launch.sh scripts/train/debug/oc_sft_olmo3_7b_1node.sh train
100	```
101	
102	What a healthy run looks like: 1,723 steps for the epoch, CE from ~1.20 down to
103	~0.65, smooth, with no instability after the LR peaks around step 52. Step count is
104	a function of the mixture and chat template, not a constant — `tokenizer_default`
105	resolves to the tokenizer's own template, which prepends a function-calling system
106	block to every conversation without a system message, so rows average 840 tokens
107	rather than the ~643 you get under the `olmo_thinker` templates.
108	
109	Checkpoints are written every 345 steps — five per epoch, which is what the eval
110	table below covers — into the directory the job logs as `CHECKPOINT_OUTPUT_DIR`.
111	
112	If the job stays queued, run `beaker job events <job-id>` and read the scheduler's own
113	reason — the two common ones need opposite fixes, and both are spelled out in the
114	script header. Do not guess from cluster docs.
115	
116	### 3. Convert checkpoints to HuggingFace
117	
118	olmo-eval can serve a raw olmo-core checkpoint, but the verified path exports to HF
119	first. One 0-GPU job per checkpoint:
120	
121	```bash
122	CKPT=<the checkpoint directory the training job wrote to>
123	STEP=1723
124	BEAKER_IMAGE=<the image build_image_and_launch.sh printed in step 1>
125	
126	uv run python mason.py \
127	    --cluster ai2/saturn ai2/neptune ai2/ceres \
128	    --workspace ai2/open-instruct-dev \
129	    --priority urgent \
130	    --image "$BEAKER_IMAGE" \
131	    --description "Convert Olmo-3-7B SFT step$STEP -> HF" \
132	    --pure_docker_mode \
133	    --num_nodes 1 \
134	    --gpus 0 \
135	    --no_auto_dataset_cache \
136	    -- uv run python scripts/train/convert_olmo_core_to_hf.py \
137	    --checkpoint-dir $CKPT/step$STEP/model_and_optim \
138	    --model-name allenai/Olmo-3-1025-7B \
139	    --tokenizer-name allenai/olmo-3-tokenizer-instruct-dev \
140	    --output-dir $CKPT/hf_step$STEP
141	```
142	
143	Pass the same tokenizer you trained with. The exported directory carries its chat
144	template, which is what makes the model answer chat-formatted eval prompts at all.
145	
146	### 4. Evaluate
147	
148	From an olmo-eval checkout, one job per checkpoint on 1 GPU (~15 min each).
149	`$CKPT` and `$STEP` are the same as in step 3:
150	
151	```bash
152	uv run olmo-eval beaker launch \
153	    -n olmo3-7b-sft-step$STEP \
154	    -m $CKPT/hf_step$STEP \
155	    -t ifeval_ood -t gsm8k \
156	    --harness default \
157	    -o provider.tokenizer=allenai/olmo-3-tokenizer-instruct-dev \
158	    -c ai2/ceres -c ai2/jupiter \
159	    -w ai2/open-instruct-dev \
160	    -B ai2/oe-other \
161	    -p urgent \
162	    --no-follow
163	```
164	
165	Evaluate the base model the same way, with `-m allenai/Olmo-3-1025-7B`, so the delta
166	isolates the weights. `ifeval_ood` (IFBench, 300 prompts) moves early under
167	instruction tuning and `gsm8k` (1,319 problems) is the regression check; both are
168	cheap. Swap in a larger suite once you care about a specific claim.
169	
170	Results print as a `Results Summary` table at the end of the job log and are written
171	to `/results/metrics.json`:
172	
173	| checkpoint | epoch | `ifeval_ood` | `gsm8k` |
174	|---|---|---|---|
175	| base `Olmo-3-1025-7B` | 0.00 | 0.1833 | 0.7430 |
176	| step 345 | 0.20 | 0.2367 | 0.7210 |
177	| step 690 | 0.40 | 0.2200 | 0.7445 |
178	| step 1035 | 0.60 | 0.2133 | 0.7362 |
179	| step 1380 | 0.80 | 0.2633 | 0.7597 |
180	| step 1723 | 1.00 | 0.2500 | 0.7612 |
181	
182	Treat differences of a few points as noise: the standard error on an IFBench
183	difference is ~3.5 points at 300 prompts, so the shape of that column is flat after
184	the first checkpoint, and the apparent peak at step 1380 is not separable from
185	sampling variation.
186	
187	!!! warning "A metric of exactly 0.0000 is a broken run, not a bad model"
188	    olmo-eval reports the experiment as `Success` when every generation request
189	    fails. It is almost always a missing chat template — check the `-m` directory has
190	    one, and that `provider.tokenizer` points at a tokenizer that does.
191	
192	### Changing the recipe
193	
194	- **Other base models.** `--config_name` must resolve to an olmo-core
195	  `TransformerConfig` preset; there is no fallback if it does not. Architectures
196	  olmo-core has no preset or HF weight conversion for need both written first —
197	  see the Olmo-Hybrid report above for what that costs.
198	- **Other node counts.** Hold the global batch at 1,048,576 tokens:
199	  `per_device × grad_accum × (world_size / cp_degree) × seq_len`. Adjust
200	  `gradient_accumulation_steps`, not the sequence length.
201	- **Verify conversions numerically.** If you write or change olmo-core ↔ HF weight
202	  conversion, compare a forward pass against the HF reference before training on it.
203	  Structural checks — key and shape matching, config round trips, state-dict round
204	  trips — all pass cleanly on numerically broken code; in the Olmo-Hybrid work three
205	  green CPU checks missed a 38% logit error caused by a single hardcoded epsilon.

    --priority urgent \
    --image "$BEAKER_IMAGE" \
    --description "Convert Olmo-3-7B SFT step$STEP -> HF" \
    --pure_docker_mode \
    --num_nodes 1 \
    --gpus 0 \
    --no_auto_dataset_cache \
    -- uv run python scripts/train/convert_olmo_core_to_hf.py \
    --checkpoint-dir $CKPT/step$STEP/model_and_optim \
    --model-name allenai/Olmo-3-1025-7B \
    --tokenizer-name allenai/olmo-3-tokenizer-instruct-dev \
    --output-dir $CKPT/hf_step$STEP
```

Pass the same tokenizer you trained with. The exported directory carries its chat
template, which is what makes the model answer chat-formatted eval prompts at all.

### 4. Evaluate

From an olmo-eval checkout, one job per checkpoint on 1 GPU (~15 min each).
`$CKPT` and `$STEP` are the same as in step 3:

```bash
uv run olmo-eval beaker launch \
    -n olmo3-7b-sft-step$STEP \
    -m $CKPT/hf_step$STEP \
    -t ifeval_ood -t gsm8k \
    --harness default \
    -o provider.tokenizer=allenai/olmo-3-tokenizer-instruct-dev \
    -c ai2/ceres -c ai2/jupiter \
    -w ai2/open-instruct-dev \
    -B ai2/oe-other \
    -p urgent \
    --no-follow
```

Evaluate the base model the same way, with `-m allenai/Olmo-3-1025-7B`, so the delta
isolates the weights. `ifeval_ood` (IFBench, 300 prompts) moves early under
instruction tuning and `gsm8k` (1,319 problems) is the regression check; both are
cheap. Swap in a larger suite once you care about a specific claim.

Results print as a `Results Summary` table at the end of the job log and are written
to `/results/metrics.json`:

| checkpoint | epoch | `ifeval_ood` | `gsm8k` |
|---|---|---|---|
| base `Olmo-3-1025-7B` | 0.00 | 0.1833 | 0.7430 |
| step 345 | 0.20 | 0.2367 | 0.7210 |
| step 690 | 0.40 | 0.2200 | 0.7445 |
| step 1035 | 0.60 | 0.2133 | 0.7362 |
| step 1380 | 0.80 | 0.2633 | 0.7597 |
| step 1723 | 1.00 | 0.2500 | 0.7612 |

Treat differences of a few points as noise: the standard error on an IFBench
difference is ~3.5 points at 300 prompts, so the shape of that column is flat after
the first checkpoint, and the apparent peak at step 1380 is not separable from
sampling variation.

!!! warning "A metric of exactly 0.0000 is a broken run, not a bad model"
    olmo-eval reports the experiment as `Success` when every generation request
    fails. It is almost always a missing chat template — check the `-m` directory has
    one, and that `provider.tokenizer` points at a tokenizer that does.

### Changing the recipe

- **Other base models.** `--config_name` must resolve to an olmo-core
  `TransformerConfig` preset; there is no fallback if it does not. Architectures
  olmo-core has no preset or HF weight conversion for need both written first —
  see the Olmo-Hybrid report above for what that costs.
- **Other node counts.** Hold the global batch at 1,048,576 tokens:
  `per_device × grad_accum × (world_size / cp_degree) × seq_len`. Adjust
  `gradient_accumulation_steps`, not the sequence length.
- **Verify conversions numerically.** If you write or change olmo-core ↔ HF weight
  conversion, compare a forward pass against the HF reference before training on it.
  Structural checks — key and shape matching, config round trips, state-dict round
  trips — all pass cleanly on numerically broken code; in the Olmo-Hybrid work three
  green CPU checks missed a 38% logit error caused by a single hardcoded epsilon.

#!/bin/bash
set -eo pipefail

BEAKER_USER=$(beaker account whoami --format json | jq -r '.[0].name')
BEAKER_IMAGE="${1:-${BEAKER_USER}/open-instruct-integration-test}"
shift || true
PYTEST_ARGS=("$@")

echo "Using Beaker image: $BEAKER_IMAGE"
if [[ ${#PYTEST_ARGS[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
    echo "Pytest filter: ${PYTEST_ARGS[*]}"
fi

case "$BEAKER_IMAGE" in
    *-cuda13|*-cuda13-moe)
        CUDA_VERSION=13
        CLUSTERS=(ai2/holmes)
        ;;
    *)
        CUDA_VERSION=12
        CLUSTERS=(ai2/jupiter ai2/ceres ai2/saturn)
        ;;
esac

CLUSTER_ARGS=()
for cluster in "${CLUSTERS[@]}"; do
    CLUSTER_ARGS+=(--cluster "$cluster")
done

echo "Using CUDA $CUDA_VERSION test clusters: ${CLUSTERS[*]}"
uv run python mason.py \
       "${CLUSTER_ARGS[@]}" \
       --image "$BEAKER_IMAGE" \
       --description "CUDA $CUDA_VERSION GPU tests for test_*_gpu.py" \
       --pure_docker_mode \
       --workspace ai2/open-instruct-dev \
       --priority urgent \
       --preemptible \
       --num_nodes 1 \
       --max_retries 0 \
       --no-host-networking \
       --gpus 1 \
       --env GIT_COMMIT="$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)" \
       --env GIT_BRANCH="$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)" \
       -- bash scripts/test/run_gpu_tests.sh "${PYTEST_ARGS[@]}"

        oc_tokenizer_config,

    global_rank, world_size, is_main_process = olmo_core_utils.setup_distributed_env(
        seed=args.tracking.seed, timeout=datetime.timedelta(hours=args.sft.dist_timeout_hours)
    )

    if is_main_process:
        os.makedirs(args.checkpoint.output_dir, exist_ok=True)
    if is_distributed():
        dist.barrier()

    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

    model, model_config = olmo_core_utils.setup_model(
        args.model, tc, init_device="meta", emo_segments_from_doc_lens=args.sft.document_boundaries_from_metadata
    )
    # MoE v2 models refuse FSDP and train through OLMo-core's DDP train module instead.
    is_ddp_model = isinstance(model, ddp_model_lib.OLMoDDPModel)

    _check_expert_parallel_degree(args.training.expert_parallel_degree, is_ddp_model, world_size)
    cp_config = olmo_core_utils.build_cp_config(args.training)
    if is_ddp_model:
        _check_ddp_model_args(args, use_hf_ckpt, cp_config)
        olmo_core_utils.require_transformer_engine()
    cp_degree = args.training.cp_degree or 1
    gpus_per_node = torch.cuda.device_count() if torch.cuda.is_available() else 1
    dp_shard_degree = gpus_per_node // cp_degree

    dp_config = train_module_lib.TransformerDataParallelConfig(
        name=parallel.DataParallelType.hsdp if world_size > dp_shard_degree else parallel.DataParallelType.fsdp,
        param_dtype=DType.bfloat16,
        reduce_dtype=DType.float32,
        shard_degree=dp_shard_degree,
    )

    ac_config = olmo_core_utils.build_ac_config(
        args.training.activation_memory_budget,
        args.training.compile_model,
        args.training.activation_checkpointing_mode,
        args.training.activation_checkpointing_modules,
    )

    rank_batch_size_seqs = args.training.per_device_train_batch_size * args.training.gradient_accumulation_steps
    rank_microbatch_size = args.training.per_device_train_batch_size * args.training.max_seq_length
    dp_world_size = world_size // cp_degree

    """Whether to checkpoint asynchronously: never for OLMoDDPModel (MoE v2) models.

    OLMo-core's async save rejects train modules that save their own state dict, as the DDP
    train module does, so the first checkpoint would end the run.
    """
    if save_async and is_ddp_model:
        logger.warning("Saving checkpoints synchronously: OLMo-core cannot save an OLMoDDPModel asynchronously.")
        return False
    return save_async

commit fc882e43369f7ad0854c3a7d1e07d68041f18642
Author: Abhishek Rao <abhishekraok@users.noreply.github.com>

    Add a CUDA 13 MoE image with transformer-engine for MoE v2 SFT (#2298)
    
    * Add a CUDA 13 MoE image variant with transformer-engine for MoE v2 SFT
    
    MoE v2 (OLMoDDPModel) token permutation needs transformer-engine, which no
    open-instruct image installed. build_image_and_launch.sh --cuda-version 13 --moe
    builds a variant on the CUDA 13.3.1 cuDNN base with transformer-engine 2.16.1
    (bindings compiled against the venv's torch 2.10). TE's prebuilt cu13 library
    needs cublasLtGroupedMatrixLayoutInit_internal, which torch's bundled cuBLAS
    13.1.0.3 lacks, so the variant points torch's bundled cuBLAS at the system copy
    and checks the symbol at build time. Default images are unchanged.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
    
    * Run GPU tests for -cuda13-moe images on CUDA 13 clusters
    
    run_gpu_pytest.sh picks holmes only for image names ending in -cuda13, so a
    -cuda13-moe image would have gone to the CUDA 12 clusters.

index ed97f57fe..d243de66e 100644
--- a/Dockerfile
+++ b/Dockerfile
@@ -1,9 +1,15 @@
 ARG CUDA_VERSION=12
+# "" or "-moe" (CUDA 13 only): the -moe image adds transformer-engine for MoE v2 models; see below.
+ARG IMAGE_VARIANT=""
 FROM nvidia/cuda:12.8.1-devel-ubuntu22.04 AS cuda12
 FROM nvidia/cuda:13.0.3-devel-ubuntu22.04 AS cuda13
-FROM cuda${CUDA_VERSION}
+FROM nvidia/cuda:13.3.1-cudnn-devel-ubuntu22.04 AS cuda13-moe
+# torch is built with CUDA 13.0; without this DeepSpeed refuses to JIT-build its ops (CPU Adam) against 13.3.
+ENV DS_SKIP_CUDA_CHECK=1
+FROM cuda${CUDA_VERSION}${IMAGE_VARIANT}
 
 ARG CUDA_VERSION
+ARG IMAGE_VARIANT
 
 ARG DEBIAN_FRONTEND="noninteractive"
 ENV TZ="America/Los_Angeles" \
@@ -79,6 +85,32 @@ RUN --mount=type=cache,target=${UV_CACHE_DIR} \
     uv run --frozen --no-default-groups --group dev --group cuda${CUDA_VERSION} \
         python -m nltk.downloader punkt punkt_tab words
 
+# MoE v2 models (OLMoDDPModel, e.g. Olmo 3.5 Small) need transformer-engine's token-permutation kernels
+# (olmo_core/nn/moe/utils.py). Only the -moe image gets it, so the default images are unchanged:
+# - TE 2.16.1's prebuilt cu13 library calls cublasLtGroupedMatrixLayoutInit_internal, which torch's
+#   bundled cuBLAS (nvidia-cublas 13.1.0.3) does not export. torch's bundled libcublas/libcublasLt are
+#   pointed at the base image's newer system copies; LD_LIBRARY_PATH cannot do it, because torch loads
+#   the bundled path. That changes cuBLAS for everything in the image, hence a separate variant.
+# - The torch bindings compile against the venv's torch (--no-build-isolation, build tools first) and
+#   the venv's cuDNN headers. TE_MAX_JOBS=2 fits Docker Desktop's 8 GiB VM; raise it on a Linux host.
+ARG TE_MAX_JOBS=2
+RUN --mount=type=cache,target=${UV_CACHE_DIR} \
+    if [ "$IMAGE_VARIANT" = "-moe" ]; then \
+        uv pip install cmake ninja pybind11 setuptools wheel && \
+        CUDNN_DIR=$(/stage/.venv/bin/python -c "import nvidia.cudnn; print(list(nvidia.cudnn.__path__)[0])") && \
+        CUDNN_PATH="$CUDNN_DIR" \
+        CPLUS_INCLUDE_PATH="$CUDNN_DIR/include" \
+        C_INCLUDE_PATH="$CUDNN_DIR/include" \
+        LIBRARY_PATH="$CUDNN_DIR/lib" \
+        MAX_JOBS="$TE_MAX_JOBS" uv pip install --no-build-isolation "transformer-engine[pytorch]==2.16.1" && \
+        for lib in libcublasLt libcublas; do \
+            target=$(ls /usr/local/cuda/lib64/${lib}.so.13.* | head -1) && [ -n "$target" ] && \
+            ln -sf "$target" /stage/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/nvidia/cu13/lib/${lib}.so.13 || exit 1; \
+        done && \
+        nm -D --defined-only /stage/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/nvidia/cu13/lib/libcublasLt.so.13 \
+            | grep -q cublasLtGroupedMatrixLayoutInit_internal; \
+    fi
+
 # Separate COPY commands required: Docker copies directory *contents*, not the directory itself
 COPY configs configs
 COPY scripts scripts

# u7-l5 SFT 配方启动器：scripts/train/sft.py、A4B 配方与 CUDA 13 MoE 镜像

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 理解「配方（recipe）」的运行模型：一条 `uv run python scripts/train/sft.py --recipe <名字>` 命令如何展开成一个完整的 Beaker 任务，为什么它**不需要先构建镜像、不需要先提交代码**。
2. 读懂 `RECIPES` 字典里 c12r 与 a4b 两个配方的每一类字段，并能说出两者在镜像、基座、学习率、并行与显存、超时预算上的关键差异及其动机。
3. 解释 A4B（MoE v2 / `OLMoDDPModel`）训练为什么必须换镜像：transformer-engine 依赖、cuda13-moe 镜像变体如何构建、以及缺 TE 时启动期的报错防线。
4. 会用 `--dry_run` 与 `tests/test_sft_recipes.py` 验证配方的展开不变量。

本讲是「从零跑通」与「读懂入口」之后的** launch 层**：u7-l1 精读了训练入口 `open_instruct/olmo_core_finetune.py`，本讲讲的是站在它上面、把一整次已知可跑的训练固化成一条命令的启动器。

## 2. 前置知识

- **Beaker 与 mason.py**（u1-l4、u9-l1）：Beaker 是 Ai2 的 GPU 任务平台；`mason.py` 把一条训练命令包装成 Beaker 任务（注入镜像、环境变量、数据挂载）。`--pure_docker_mode` 表示直接用镜像自带环境运行；`--min_runtime` 设置 Beaker 的 `minRuntime`（受保护最短运行时，至少 5 分钟且带单位）；`--auto_resume` 设置 `autoResume`（被抢占后自动重排）。
- **MoE v2 / OLMoDDPModel**（u1-l2、u1-l4）：Olmo 3.5 Small（A4B）是混合专家模型，其 MoE 层的 token permutation（专家分发前的重排）调用 transformer-engine（TE）的算子；它拒绝 FSDP，走 OLMo-core 的 DDP 训练模块。
- **numpy 预编码缓存**（u3-l2、u7-l1）：OLMo-core 路线的 SFT 不在训练时现分词，而是先跑一个 CPU 分词作业，把 token 流写成可 mmap 的 numpy 文件；训练启动时若缓存目录不命中会直接硬失败。
- **transformer-engine（TE）**：NVIDIA 的训练库，这里只用到它的 `pytorch.permutation` 一组算子。它是**预编译二进制 + 从源码编译的 torch 绑定**的混合体，因此对镜像里 torch/cuBLAS 的版本非常敏感——这是本讲镜像变体一节的伏笔。
- **配方（recipe）**：本讲的核心概念——把一次已知良好的训练运行（基座、数据、超参、镜像、集群、超时）固化成一个字典，让「换个基座重跑」「断点续跑」都退化成一条命令加一两个覆盖参数。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| [scripts/train/sft.py](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/scripts/train/sft.py) | 配方启动器：`RECIPES` 注册表 + 把配方展开成 mason 命令的 `main` |
| [tests/test_sft_recipes.py](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/tests/test_sft_recipes.py) | 用 `--dry_run` 断言每个配方展开不变量的测试 |
| [Dockerfile](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/Dockerfile) | cuda12 / cuda13 / cuda13-moe 三种训练镜像的构建定义 |
| [scripts/train/build_image_and_launch.sh](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/scripts/train/build_image_and_launch.sh) | 统一构建/启动入口：`--cuda-version 13 --moe` 构建并使用 MoE 变体镜像 |

| [open_instruct/olmo_core_utils.py](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/open_instruct/olmo_core_utils.py) | `require_transformer_engine`：缺 TE 时的启动期报错（含修复命令） |
| [open_instruct/olmo_core_finetune.py](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/open_instruct/olmo_core_finetune.py) | 训练入口（u7-l1 已精读）：numpy 缓存解析、TE 检查调用点、checkpoint 语义 |
| [docs/algorithms/sft_running_guide.md](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/docs/algorithms/sft_running_guide.md) | 用户文档：两个配方的一句话说明、告诫与速度估计 |

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 配方注册表与 mason 命令拼装

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

`scripts/train/sft.py` 解决的问题是：一次 SFT 实验牵涉**十几个训练参数、一个固定镜像、一个集群布局、一份预分词缓存、一组超时预算**，任何一项手抄错都会浪费一次 2×8 B300、几十小时的运行。配方把这些全部固化进一个字典，使得：

- **一条命令即一次完整运行**：`uv run python scripts/train/sft.py --recipe c12r`。
- **训练代码来自镜像而非当前 checkout**：每个配方固定（pin）它运行所用的 Beaker 镜像 ID。镜像里装好了依赖、拷进了当时的 `open_instruct/` 与 `scripts/` 代码。所以你不需要先构建镜像、也不需要先提交代码——你本地的 checkout 只用来**生成** mason 命令。模块 docstring 把这一点写得很直白：[scripts/train/sft.py:L6-L8](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/scripts/train/sft.py#L6-L8)（训练代码来自镜像；重复执行同名命令会从输出目录最新 checkpoint 恢复，目录无时间戳）。
- **断点续跑无时间戳**：输出目录名只含 run 名（如 `a4b-s34521`），不含时间戳。重复执行同一条命令会落进同一个目录，从最新 checkpoint 恢复；配合 mason 的 `--auto_resume`，Beaker 抢占后也会自动重排续跑。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

```text
uv run python scripts/train/sft.py --recipe a4b [--checkpoint DIR --name RUN | --seed N | --steps N] [--dry_run]
        │
        ├─ 1. argparse 解析；从 RECIPES 取配方
        ├─ 2. 派生 run 名（默认 <recipe>-s<seed>[(-<steps>st)]）并校验字符集
        ├─ 3. beaker account whoami 取用户名 → output_dir = /weka/.../sft/<user>/<name>
        ├─ 4. 拼训练命令 train = [torchrun --nnodes=N ... open_instruct/olmo_core_finetune.py
        │        --model_name_or_path <checkpoint>  + recipe["train_args"]
        │        + --max_train_steps/--checkpointing_steps/--ephemeral_save_interval
        │        + --data_loader_seed/--run_name/--output_dir]
        ├─ 5. 拼 mason 命令 = [python mason.py --cluster --workspace --budget --image
        │        --pure_docker_mode --num_nodes --gpus 8 --priority --min_runtime --auto_resume
        │        --timeout --extra_weka_buckets --env OLMO_SHARED_FS=1
        │        --env EXPECTED_NUMPY_CACHE=<cache>  + recipe["env"] 逐项 --env
        │        --task_name --description  --  + train]
        └─ 6. --dry_run ? 打印命令 : subprocess.run(mason) 真正提交 Beaker
```

checkpoint 策略也在这里统一计算：全程中点一个永久 checkpoint，另外每 1000 步（`SAVE_EVERY`）一个临时（ephemeral）恢复点——OLMo-core 要求临时保存频率**严格高于**永久保存，见 [scripts/train/sft.py:L259-L262](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/scripts/train/sft.py#L259-L262) 的注释。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

**① 配方字典的结构**。以 c12r 为例（[scripts/train/sft.py:L27-L38](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/scripts/train/sft.py#L27-L38)）：`image`（Beaker 镜像 ID）、`checkpoint`（起始的 OLMo-core DCP 权重目录）、`steps`（18,410 步——注释解释这是 seed 34521 的加载顺序恰好消费半个 epoch C12 的第一步，其他 seed 只差几步）、`seed`（数据加载顺序种子）、`cache`（冻结的预分词缓存名）、`train_args`（直接喂给 `olmo_core_finetune.py` 的参数列表）、可选 `env`（额外环境变量）、`cluster`/`nodes`/`timeout`/`min_runtime`（Beaker 侧预算）。

**② run 名与输出目录的派生**（[scripts/train/sft.py:L229-L247](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/scripts/train/sft.py#L229-L247)）：默认名 `<recipe>-s<seed>`；显式 `--steps` 会追加 `-<steps>st` 后缀，让短跑进自己的目录、之后的完整运行不会从短跑的 checkpoint 恢复（L234-235 注释）。`--checkpoint` 换基座时**必须**同时给 `--name`（L230-231），防止你的自定义运行恢复进默认 run 的目录。名字还要过一道正则校验（L236-237），因为它会被拼进 Weka 路径。`beaker account whoami` 失败且非 dry_run 时直接报错退出；dry_run 则用 `<user>` 占位（L240-246）。

**③ 训练命令的拼装**（[scripts/train/sft.py:L249-L264](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/scripts/train/sft.py#L249-L264)）：多机启动用 `torchrun --nnodes=<nodes> --node_rank=$BEAKER_REPLICA_RANK --master_addr=$BEAKER_LEADER_REPLICA_HOSTNAME --master_port=29400 --nproc_per_node=8`——`$BEAKER_*` 是 Beaker 注入的多机拓扑环境变量。注意 L255-256 的注释与 `shlex.quote`：mason 把命令拼给 `bash -c` 时**不会**给普通参数加引号，所以 checkpoint 路径要自己 quote。

**④ mason 命令的拼装与缓存防线**（[scripts/train/sft.py:L265-L278](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/scripts/train/sft.py#L265-L278)）：镜像、集群、`--gpus 8`、`--min_runtime`/`--timeout`/`--auto_resume` 全部来自配方；`--extra_weka_buckets` 挂载基座 checkpoint 所在的 Weka 桶。两个固定环境变量之外，配方的 `env` 列表被逐项展开成 `--env <VAR=VAL>`（L273 的列表推导）。其中 `EXPECTED_NUMPY_CACHE=<cache>`（L272）是**缓存身份防线**：配方的 cache 值（如 `bf82a8fab8-6068a350-rowaligned`）必须与作业实际解析到的缓存目录一致，否则作业在训练开始前死掉——c12r 的注释（[scripts/train/sft.py:L36-L38](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/scripts/train/sft.py#L36-L38)）说明 mixer、tokenizer、模板或 `--seed` 任一项不同都会解析到不同缓存。

这个环境变量的**读取方在固定镜像内的训练代码里**——在当前 main checkout 中 grep 不到 `EXPECTED_NUMPY_CACHE` 的消费者，这正是「训练代码来自镜像」的直接证据。main 上等价的保护在训练入口：缓存目录名由 `compute_config_hash(dcs, tc)` 加种子后缀拼出（[open_instruct/olmo_core_finetune.py:L557-L564](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/open_instruct/olmo_core_finetune.py#L557-L564)），目录不命中时抛 `FileNotFoundError` 并打印可直接复制的分词作业命令（[open_instruct/olmo_core_finetune.py:L576-L622](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/open_instruct/olmo_core_finetune.py#L576-L622)）。

**⑤ 缓存目录名的组成**（[open_instruct/olmo_core_finetune.py:L94-L111](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/open_instruct/olmo_core_finetune.py#L94-L111)）：

\[
\text{目录名} = \underbrace{\text{config\_hash}}_{\text{mixer/分词器/模板/长度}} - \underbrace{\text{sha256}(\texttt{"seed:max\_seq\_length"})[:8]}_{\text{种子后缀}} + \texttt{"-rowaligned"}
\]

两个种子要分清：`train_args` 里的 `--seed 33333` 是 `args.tracking.seed`，**参与缓存目录命名**（所以注释说「--seed names the cache」）；配方的 `seed` 字段（34521）经 `--data_loader_seed` 进入训练，只决定**数据顺序**。这也解释了 run 名为什么是 `a4b-s34521` 而缓存名里的后缀来自 33333——按上式应为 `sha256("33333:65536")` 的前 8 位（可用一行 Python 本地验证）。

#### 4.1.4 代码实践

1. **实践目标**：不提交任何 Beaker 任务，看到 a4b 配方展开出的完整 mason 命令。
2. **操作步骤**：在仓库根目录运行 `uv run python scripts/train/sft.py --recipe a4b --dry_run`。
3. **需要观察的现象**：第一行 `Output: /weka/oe-adapt-default/allennlp/deletable_checkpoint/<user>/sft/a4b-s34521`（无 beaker CLI 时 `<user>` 是占位符），第二行是完整的 `python mason.py ...` 命令。
4. **预期结果**：命令里能依次找到 `--image 01M7VCQM65SD251KYS4Z1AD8FG`、`--cluster ai2/holmes`、`--num_nodes 2`、`--env EXPECTED_NUMPY_CACHE=bf82a8fab8-6068a350-rowaligned`、`--env PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True`，`--` 之后以 `torchrun --nnodes=2 ...` 开头并以 `--output_dir .../a4b-s34521` 结尾。（待本地验证：本机需已 `uv sync`。）

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `--checkpoint` 必须搭配 `--name`？
**答案**：输出目录由 run 名决定。若允许换基座但不改名，新运行会落进默认 run 的目录并**从默认运行的 checkpoint 恢复**，等于静默丢弃了你指定的新基座（[scripts/train/sft.py:L230-L231](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/scripts/train/sft.py#L230-L231) 的报错信息就是这个意思）。

**练习 2**：同一个配方跑 `--steps 100` 的短测，再跑完整 18,410 步，两者会互相污染吗？
**答案**：不会。显式 `--steps` 使默认 run 名带上 `-100st` 后缀（L235），短测写进 `a4b-s34521-100st` 目录；完整运行仍写 `a4b-s34521`。

**练习 3**：`--ephemeral_save_interval` 在 18,410 步的 run 里是多少？为什么不能等于 `--checkpointing_steps`？
**答案**：`SAVE_EVERY=1000`（L22），而永久 checkpoint 在中点 `(18410+1)//2 = 9205` 步。L261-262 注释说明 OLMo-core 要求临时保存**严格更频繁**于永久保存——临时 checkpoint 服务断点续跑，永久 checkpoint 服务评估产出，两者语义不同。

### 4.2 a4b 配方：数据、优化器与显存工程

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

a4b 是 c12r 的「平行实验臂」：**数据、缓存、种子、步数完全相同**，只把基座从 dense 的 B1 换成 Olmo 3.5 Small hero（A4B MoE）的 4T decay 端点。这样实验对比只隔离「基座」这一个变量。但 MoE 模型带来三个新问题——专家放不进单卡显存、交叉熵的 logits 张量爆炸、TE 内核带来的计算图变化——a4b 的 `train_args` 增量几乎全部是对这三个问题的工程回应。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

先看两个配方的**不变量**（这是 a4b 复用 c12r 冻结缓存的前提）：

| 字段 | c12r = a4b |
|---|---|
| `steps` / `seed`（数据顺序） | 18,410 / 34521 |
| `cache` | `bf82a8fab8-6068a350-rowaligned` |
| `--mixer_list`（4 个 parquet + 权重） | 完全一致 |
| `--extra_numpy_dirs`（10% 长上下文 replay） | `/weka/.../h182/replay-b1c12r` |
| `--seed`（命名缓存） | 33333 |
| `--max_seq_length` / batch / grad accum | 65536 / 1 / 1 |

再看 a4b 的**增量**（右侧为其动机，全部来自配方内注释）：

| 增量 | 值 | 动机（源码注释原文依据） |
|---|---|---|
| 基座 | `olmo35-4b-active-4t-decay159k-causal/step162974` | A4B hero 的 4T decay 端点 |
| 峰值 LR | `7.3e-5`（c12r 为 `2e-4`） | 按两基座预训练 LR 之比缩放 |
| `--expert_parallel_degree` | `8` | 专家在节点内 8 卡间分片 |
| `--loss_implementation` | `fused_linear` | 默认 CE 物化 24.5 GiB logits 会 OOM |
| `env` | `PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True` | 否则第一次 backward 因碎片 OOM |
| `timeout` / `min_runtime` | `72h` / `2h15m`（c12r 为 `14h` / `45m`） | 步速慢约 4 倍；首个临时 checkpoint 约第 2 小时 |
| `--config_name` | `scripts/c12/a4b_sft_config.json` | **只存在于 a4b 镜像里**，main 没有 |

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

**① 学习率的推导**。a4b 的注释（[scripts/train/sft.py:L109-L113](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/scripts/train/sft.py#L109-L113)）写明：峰值 LR 是 c12r 的 2e-4 乘以两个基座预训练 LR 之比：

\[
\text{LR}_{a4b} = 2\times10^{-4} \times \frac{4.04\times10^{-4}}{1.1\times10^{-3}} \approx 7.35\times10^{-5} \;\Rightarrow\; \texttt{7.3e-5}
\]

直觉：SFT 峰值 LR 按「基座预训练最后用的 LR」等比缩放，避免对用更小 LR 训到收敛的基座施加过大扰动。

**② EP8 与数据并行批大小**。[scripts/train/sft.py:L192-L194](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/scripts/train/sft.py#L192-L194) 设置专家并行度为 8（节点内 8 卡分片专家）。L123-124 的注释解释了一个容易混淆的点：EP 把专家分片到**同样的 16 个 rank** 上，不改变数据并行的划分——每步的数据并行批大小仍是 16 条序列（2 节点 × 8 卡 × batch 1）。

**③ 显存工程三件套**：

- **fused linear+CE**（[scripts/train/sft.py:L195-L197](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/scripts/train/sft.py#L195-L197)）：注释「The default CE materialises 24.5 GiB of logits and OOMs」。65,536 的序列长度 × 大词表，默认实现会先物化整个 logits 张量再算交叉熵；`fused_linear` 把线性投影与 CE 融合，避免物化。
- **分配器设置**（[scripts/train/sft.py:L199-L200](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/scripts/train/sft.py#L199-L200)）：`expandable_segments:True` 来自 A4B 预训练配方，缓解显存碎片导致的第一次 backward OOM。它是 a4b 唯一的 `env` 项，经 mason 的 `--env` 注入。
- **整块重计算 + 关闭嵌套 checkpoint**（[scripts/train/sft.py:L115-L121](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/scripts/train/sft.py#L115-L121) 的镜像注释）：模型配置用整块重计算（recompute_each_block），同时关掉嵌套的 `checkpoint_attn` / `checkpoint_permute_moe_unpermute` / `checkpoint_second_unpermute`——#2291 实测同 CE 下 **-16% s/step**；反过来关整块重计算则直接 OOM。配套地，嵌套 checkpoint 关闭后 torch.compile 会在第一次 backward OOM，所以两个配方都传 `--no_compile_model`（a4b 的 L160-161 注释）。训练侧统一的 `--activation_checkpointing_mode budget` + `--activation_memory_budget 1` 则见 [scripts/train/sft.py:L162-L165](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/scripts/train/sft.py#L162-L165)。
- **flash_2 注意力**（[scripts/train/sft.py:L158-L159](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/scripts/train/sft.py#L158-L159)）：镜像里的 FA4 在 SM100（B300）上拒绝 head_dim 256，所以显式选 flash_2——这是「训练行为由镜像决定」的又一例：注意力实现的可用性取决于镜像里装的库版本。

**④ 必须诚实对待的告诫**（[docs/algorithms/sft_running_guide.md:L36-L40](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/docs/algorithms/sft_running_guide.md#L36-L40)）：约 7.4 s/step 与约 38 小时是**从 #2291 的 300 步基准外推的估计值**（且是在更早的镜像 `01M6XV36` 上测的）；固定镜像 `01M7VCQM65SD251KYS4Z1AD8FG` 只通过了一次 **40 步冒烟测试（8.20 s/step，步 10-40，CE 吻合）**；**尚无完整训练运行用过这个配方**。读文档时要区分「实测」「外推」与「冒烟」三种证据等级。

**⑤ 保存语义的 MoE 边界**：两个配方都传 `--no_save_async`。对 a4b 这不只是习惯——[open_instruct/olmo_core_finetune.py:L526-L535](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/open_instruct/olmo_core_finetune.py#L526-L535) 的 `_save_async` 对 `OLMoDDPModel` **强制**返回 False（OLMo-core 的异步保存拒绝自存 state dict 的 DDP 训练模块），即使忘了传 flag 也只是降级为同步保存并打警告。

#### 4.2.4 代码实践

1. **实践目标**：用缓存目录命名公式确认 a4b 与 c12r 命中**同一个** numpy 缓存目录，从而理解「换基座不重分词」。
2. **操作步骤**：(a) 读 [open_instruct/olmo_core_finetune.py:L104-L111](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/open_instruct/olmo_core_finetune.py#L104-L111) 的 `_numpy_cache_dir`；(b) 本地运行一行 Python：`import hashlib; print(hashlib.sha256(b"33333:65536").hexdigest()[:8])`；(c) 对比配方 cache 值 `bf82a8fab8-6068a350-rowaligned` 的中段。
3. **需要观察的现象**：`--seed 33333` 与 `--max_seq_length 65536` 两个值如何进入哈希；两个配方的这组值完全一致。
4. **预期结果**：哈希前缀与 `6068a350` 一致（若不一致则说明缓存名由其他机制参与，需回读 `compute_config_hash`——待本地验证）。另注意 c12r 注释「the job's cache dir holds a symlink to the frozen cache」（[scripts/train/sft.py:L94-L96](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/scripts/train/sft.py#L94-L96)）：作业的 cache 目录里放的是指向冻结缓存的符号链接，`--extra_numpy_dirs` 再把 replay 数据并进来，两者共同保证「同一份数据、同一个顺序」。

#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：a4b 的 `--extra_numpy_dirs` 指向 `h182/replay-b1c12r`，这个名字透露了什么？
**答案**：replay 数据是 c12r 所属 H182 实验线冻结的产物，a4b 直接复用——这是「数据侧零差异」设计的一部分（a4b 是 H203 的 a4b 臂，对照 c12r）。

**练习 2**：为什么 a4b 的 `min_runtime` 是 2h15m 而 c12r 只有 45m？
**答案**：`min_runtime` 要保证任务至少活过**第一个恢复点**（步 1000 的临时 checkpoint）：c12r 约第 41 分钟到达（[scripts/train/sft.py:L106-L107](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/scripts/train/sft.py#L106-L107)），a4b 按估计步速约第 2 小时到达（L204-205），故分别给 45m / 2h15m。

**练习 3**：如果有人提议「把 a4b 的嵌套 MoE checkpoint 打开以再省点显存、换更快速度」，配方注释会怎么回应？
**答案**：方向反了。#2291 的结论是**关掉**嵌套 checkpoint（保留整块重计算）才提速 -16% s/step；要再省显存只能关整块重计算，而那样会 OOM（[scripts/train/sft.py:L118-L121](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/scripts/train/sft.py#L118-L121)）。

### 4.3 CUDA 13 MoE 镜像变体与 transformer-engine

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

MoE v2（`OLMoDDPModel`）的 token permutation 调用 TE 的算子，而 open-instruct 的默认镜像（cuda12 / cuda13）**不安装 TE**。#2298 补上这条链路时没有改动默认镜像，而是新增了第三个变体 `cuda13-moe`。为什么不能把 TE 塞进默认镜像？因为 TE 2.16.1 的预编译 cu13 库需要一个 torch 自带 cuBLAS（13.1.0.3）**不导出**的符号（`cublasLtGroupedMatrixLayoutInit_internal`）；修复办法是把 torch 绑定的 cuBLAS 指向基座镜像里更新的系统副本——但这会改变镜像里**所有**代码看到的 cuBLAS，所以必须是独立变体（[Dockerfile:L88-L95](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/Dockerfile#L88-L95) 的注释逐条记录了这些理由，并说明为什么 `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` 行不通——torch 硬编码加载自带路径）。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

变体的防线分三层，失败时间逐层提前：

```text
构建期  Dockerfile cuda13-moe 阶段：
        装 TE 2.16.1（绑定 venv 的 torch 编译）→ cuBLAS 符号链接替换 → nm 检查符号存在
          ↓ 镜像
启动期  build_image_and_launch.sh --cuda-version 13 --moe：
        校验组合合法 → IMAGE_VARIANT=-moe 传给 docker build → 镜像名追加 -moe
        run_gpu_pytest.sh：*-cuda13 | *-cuda13-moe → 路由到 ai2/holmes（CUDA 13 集群）
          ↓ 任务
运行期  olmo_core_finetune.py：模型是 OLMoDDPModel → require_transformer_engine()
        → TE 缺失时立即 RuntimeError（附正确启动命令），而非等到第一次 forward
```

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

**① Dockerfile 的变体选择**（[Dockerfile:L1-L9](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/Dockerfile#L1-L9)）：两个构建参数 `CUDA_VERSION` 与 `IMAGE_VARIANT` 组合出 `FROM cuda${CUDA_VERSION}${IMAGE_VARIANT}`——三个命名基座阶段分别是 cuda12（12.8.1）、cuda13（13.0.3）与 cuda13-moe（**13.3.1-cudnn** 基座）。注意 `ENV DS_SKIP_CUDA_CHECK=1` 位于 cuda13-moe 阶段定义内（L7-8）：torch 按 CUDA 13.0 构建，没有它 DeepSpeed 拒绝对 13.3 工具链 JIT 构建自己的算子（如 CPU Adam）；由于 `ENV` 只随 `FROM cuda13-moe` 继承，**两个默认镜像不受影响**。

**② TE 安装与构建期自检**（[Dockerfile:L96-L112](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/Dockerfile#L96-L112)）：整个变体增量收在一条 `if [ "$IMAGE_VARIANT" = "-moe" ]` 守卫的 RUN 里——先装构建工具（cmake/ninja/pybind11），从 venv 定位 cuDNN 头文件与库目录，再 `uv pip install --no-build-isolation "transformer-engine[pytorch]==2.16.1"`（绑定按当前 venv 的 torch 编译，`TE_MAX_JOBS=2` 为小内存构建机留余量）；然后把 venv 里 `nvidia/cu13/lib` 的 `libcublas`/`libcublasLt` 替换为指向 `/usr/local/cuda/lib64` 系统副本的符号链接，最后 `nm -D ... | grep -q cublasLtGroupedMatrixLayoutInit_internal` 在**构建期**验证符号确实可用——链接失败或符号缺失都会让 `exit 1` 终止构建，而不是留一个运行时才炸的镜像。

**③ 启动器的 `--moe` 路由**（[scripts/train/build_image_and_launch.sh:L36-L45](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/scripts/train/build_image_and_launch.sh#L36-L45)）：`--moe` 必须搭配 `--cuda-version 13`，否则报错退出（只有 CUDA 13 镜像有 TE 变体）；随后 `image_variant="-moe"` 进入镜像名（[L73](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/scripts/train/build_image_and_launch.sh#L73)）并作为 `--build-arg IMAGE_VARIANT` 传给 docker build（[L86-L94](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/scripts/train/build_image_and_launch.sh#L86-L94)）。这与 u1-l4 讲过的「干净工作区 + 按 commit 复用镜像」流程完全共用。

**④ GPU 测试的集群路由**（[scripts/test/run_gpu_pytest.sh:L14-L23](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/scripts/test/run_gpu_pytest.sh#L14-L23)）：按镜像名整串后缀匹配 `*-cuda13|*-cuda13-moe` 才去 `ai2/holmes`，其余按 CUDA 12 处理。#2298 之前只有 `*-cuda13` 一个模式——`-cuda13-moe` 镜像会被误路由到 CUDA 12 集群（在错误驱动版本的机器上跑 CUDA 13 镜像）。

**⑤ 运行期防线及其调用点**（[open_instruct/olmo_core_utils.py:L575-L587](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/open_instruct/olmo_core_utils.py#L575-L587)）：OLMo-core 在 TE 缺失时把 permutation 算子守卫式地置为 `None`，没有检查的话模型要到**第一次 forward** 才以难懂的方式崩掉。`require_transformer_engine()` 检查 `oc_moe_utils.moe_permute is None` 并抛出带修复指引的 `RuntimeError`——报错文本直接给出正确命令 `scripts/train/build_image_and_launch.sh --cuda-version 13 --moe SCRIPT`。调用点在训练入口（[open_instruct/olmo_core_finetune.py:L648-L658](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/open_instruct/olmo_core_finetune.py#L648-L658)）：`setup_model` 之后判定 `isinstance(model, ddp_model_lib.OLMoDDPModel)`，是 MoE v2 才检查——dense 模型不需要 TE，不应被这个检查挡住。

回到配方视角：a4b 固定的镜像 `01M7VCQM65SD251KYS4Z1AD8FG` 由 a4b-bigbatch 分支线（含 #2291，open-instruct e436f7647）构建，该镜像同时携带 main 没有的 `scripts/c12/a4b_sft_config.json`（[scripts/train/sft.py:L115-L121](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/scripts/train/sft.py#L115-L121) 注释：EMO off、sync_1d EP、flash_2、整块重计算与嵌套 checkpoint 关闭都写在这个配置里）。也就是说**即使在 main 上 dry_run 成功，真正执行时读的还是镜像里的那份代码与配置**。

#### 4.3.4 代码实践

1. **实践目标**：亲自确认「默认镜像上启动 a4b 会失败」的失败方式与正确命令。
2. **操作步骤**：(a) 读 [open_instruct/olmo_core_utils.py:L575-L587](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/open_instruct/olmo_core_utils.py#L575-L587)，抄下 `RuntimeError` 的完整报错文本；(b) 读 [scripts/train/sft.py:L115-L121](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/scripts/train/sft.py#L115-L121)，确认 a4b 的 image 字段与 c12r 不同；(c) 用 `git log --oneline -- Dockerfile` 找到 #2298 提交并 `git show` 它，对照 `--moe` 分支与 `nm` 检查的引入位置。
3. **需要观察的现象**：报错文本中给出的修复命令、`--moe` 对 CUDA 版本的约束、构建期符号检查的 `exit 1` 语义。
4. **预期结果**：能回答——默认镜像（无 TE）上手动跑 A4B 时，`setup_model` 判定 MoE v2 后 `require_transformer_engine()` 立即抛 RuntimeError（不是第一次 forward 才崩）；要自己构建镜像线，正确命令是 `./scripts/train/build_image_and_launch.sh --cuda-version 13 --moe SCRIPT`；而走配方启动器，正确命令就是 `uv run python scripts/train/sft.py --recipe a4b`（镜像已固定，无需构建）。

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 cuda13-moe 用 13.3.1-**cudnn** 基座而 cuda13 用 13.0.3-devel？
**答案**：TE 的 torch 绑定要从源码编译，需要 venv 之外可用的 cuDNN 开发文件；13.3.1-cudnn-devel 基座同时提供新版系统 cuBLAS（供符号替换用）与 cuDNN（Dockerfile 注释 L88-95 与安装块 L100-105）。

**练习 2**：`DS_SKIP_CUDA_CHECK=1` 会不会影响默认镜像的行为？
**答案**：不会。它写在 cuda13-moe 命名阶段内，只有最终 `FROM cuda13-moe` 的变体镜像继承它；cuda12/cuda13 的最终阶段从各自基座起建，看不到这个 ENV。

**练习 3**：配方直接引用现成镜像 ID（`01M7VCQM...`），而仓库又有 `--cuda-version 13 --moe` 构建入口，两者什么关系？
**答案**：配方走「已经构建好、已冒烟验证」的镜像，保证可复现；`--moe` 入口让你从**当前 checkout** 构建同类变体镜像（例如你要改训练代码重跑 MoE v2 时）。前者固定不动，后者随 commit 变化。

### 4.4 配方不变量测试：tests/test_sft_recipes.py

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

启动器本身没有 GPU 逻辑，最容易出错的地方是「配方字典 → mason 命令」的**展开**：漏一个 `--env`、镜像字段拼错、训练命令没跟上 `--`，都要到提交任务后才暴露。`tests/test_sft_recipes.py` 的思路是：`--dry_run` 路径不需要 Beaker（whoami 失败时用 `<user>` 占位），所以可以在 CI 里真实执行 `sft.py main()`，再对**打印出的命令**做断言——把「计划一次发射」本身当成被测行为（文件 docstring 原话：every recipe plans a launch, and the A4B recipe keeps what makes it run）。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

```text
importlib 按 fixture 路径加载 scripts/train/sft.py（它不是包内模块）
        ↓
plan()：monkeypatch 掉 subprocess.run（连 beaker whoami 都不真正执行）
        设 sys.argv = ["sft.py", --recipe, name, --dry_run] → 调 sft.main()
        从 capsys 抓 stdout 最后一行 → shlex.split 成参数列表
        ↓
断言配方不变量：--image / --num_nodes / --cluster / --max_train_steps /
--data_loader_seed / --run_name / EXPECTED_NUMPY_CACHE / 每个 recipe env 前面是 --env /
"--" 之后以 torchrun --nnodes=<nodes> 开头
```

#### 4.4.3 源码精读

**① 把脚本当模块加载**（[tests/test_sft_recipes.py:L10-L14](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/tests/test_sft_recipes.py#L10-L14)）：`scripts/train/` 不是包，测试用 `importlib.util.spec_from_file_location` 直接从路径加载并 `exec_module`——这也顺带执行了模块顶层的 `RECIPES` 定义。

**② plan 辅助函数**（[tests/test_sft_recipes.py:L17-L28](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/tests/test_sft_recipes.py#L17-L28)）：把 `sft.subprocess.run` 换成必抛 `OSError` 的假函数，使 whoami 走进 dry_run 的占位分支；断言第一行输出以 `Output: /weka/oe-adapt-default/allennlp/deletable_checkpoint/<user>/sft/` 开头，然后取**最后一行**（mason 命令）做 `shlex.split`。

**③ 逐配方参数化断言**（[tests/test_sft_recipes.py:L35-L50](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/tests/test_sft_recipes.py#L35-L50)）：`@pytest.mark.parametrize` 遍历 `sorted(sft.RECIPES)`，**新增配方自动纳入测试**。断言逐项对照：`--image` 等于配方字段、`--num_nodes`/`--cluster`/`--max_train_steps`/`--data_loader_seed` 同理、`--run_name` 是 `<name>-s<seed>`、`EXPECTED_NUMPY_CACHE=<cache>` 在参数列表里、配方的每个 env 字符串**前一个参数是 `--env`**（L46-47 用 `cmd.index(env) - 1` 检查，防止 env 被拼进训练命令）、`--` 之后前两项是 `torchrun --nnodes=<nodes>`（L49-50）。

**④ a4b 专属不变量**（[tests/test_sft_recipes.py:L53-L71](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/tests/test_sft_recipes.py#L53-L71)）：这一组断言编码了 4.2/4.3 节讲的所有「a4b 之所以能跑」的条件——镜像**不同于** c12r（L55-56 注释直说：main 的镜像没有 TE）；`--config_name` 指向镜像内的 `scripts/c12/a4b_sft_config.json`；基座路径前缀正确；`--expert_parallel_degree` 为 8；`--loss_implementation` 为 `fused_linear`；LR 为 7.3e-5；含 `--no_compile_model` 与分配器 env；最后把 `--mixer_list` 到 `--local_cache_dir` 之间的整段（即完整 mixer）与 c12r 逐参数对比，连同 `--extra_numpy_dirs`/`--seed`/`--max_train_steps`/`--max_seq_length` 一起断言相等——**用测试锁死「a4b 与 c12r 数据侧零差异」这个实验设计**。

#### 4.4.4 代码实践

1. **实践目标**：在本地跑通配方不变量测试，并观察它如何抓住一个故意注入的错误。
2. **操作步骤**：(a) 运行 `uv run pytest tests/test_sft_recipes.py -v`；(b) 临时把 `scripts/train/sft.py` 里 a4b 的 `"learning_rate"` 值改为 `7.4e-5`（改完**记得还原**，本仓库不允许留下源码修改），再跑一次同一条 pytest 命令观察失败信息；(c) 还原后重跑确认全绿。
3. **需要观察的现象**：三个用例（c12r、a4b 的参数化用例 + a4b 专属用例）通过；注入错误后 `test_a4b_recipe` 在 `assert value(cmd, "--learning_rate") == "7.3e-5"` 处失败。
4. **预期结果**：全部通过；改动学习率后恰好一条断言失败并指出实际值。（待本地验证：需已 `uv sync`；步骤 (b) 只在本地实验，勿提交。）

#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么测试要专门断言 `EXPECTED_NUMPY_CACHE=...` 在**命令参数**里，而不是去检查缓存目录存在？
**答案**：这是「展开不变量」测试：它验证启动器把配方字段正确注入 mason 命令。缓存目录是否存在是 Weka 上的运行时事实，单测环境既无法访问、也不该访问——那属于作业启动后训练入口的职责（缓存不命中会硬失败，见 4.1.3 ⑤）。

**练习 2**：`cmd[cmd.index(env) - 1] == "--env"` 这个看似奇怪的断言防的是什么 bug？
**答案**：防止配方 env 列表被**拼错位置**——比如忘了 `--env` 前缀，`PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True` 就会落到 `--` 之后的训练命令里，变成一个无效参数。断言用「env 字符串前一个 token 必须是 `--env`」锁住注入点（[tests/test_sft_recipes.py:L46-L47](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/tests/test_sft_recipes.py#L46-L47)）。

**练习 3**：新增第三个配方时，测试需要怎么改？
**答案**：`test_recipe_plans_a_launch` 因 parametrize 自动覆盖新配方，不需要改；只有当新配方有自己的「必须保真」的差异点（像 a4b 的 TE 镜像、EP8、fused_linear）时，才补一个类似 `test_a4b_recipe` 的专属用例。

## 5. 综合实践

把本讲四个模块串起来的任务（全程无需 GPU，也无需提交 Beaker 任务）：

**第一步：画出展开流程图。** 对照 [scripts/train/sft.py:L249-L283](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/scripts/train/sft.py#L249-L283)，绘制「本地命令 → 配方展开 → mason 标志 → Beaker 任务」的流程图：`--image/--cluster/--num_nodes/--min_runtime/--timeout` 各标一个来源字段；`--env` 标三个来源（固定的 `OLMO_SHARED_FS=1`、`EXPECTED_NUMPY_CACHE`、recipe env 列表）；`--` 之后标出 torchrun 前缀与 `olmo_core_finetune.py` 及其参数的三个来源（`--checkpoint` 覆盖项、`recipe["train_args"]`、main 里现算的 `--max_train_steps`/`--checkpointing_steps`/`--ephemeral_save_interval`/`--data_loader_seed`/`--run_name`/`--output_dir`）。

**第二步：dry_run 并标注。** 运行 `uv run python scripts/train/sft.py --recipe a4b --dry_run`，在打印的命令上用三种颜色/记号分别标出：来自 `recipe["env"]` 的参数（应只有 `PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True`）、来自 `recipe["train_args"]` 的参数（从 `--config_name` 到 `--loss_implementation fused_linear`）、来自 main 现算的参数（`--max_train_steps 18410`、`--checkpointing_steps 9205`、`--ephemeral_save_interval 1000`、`--data_loader_seed 34521`、`--run_name`、`--output_dir`）。再解释 `EXPECTED_NUMPY_CACHE` 与 `--extra_numpy_dirs` 如何让 a4b 复用 c12r 的冻结缓存：两个配方 mixer/分词器/模板/`--seed 33333`/`--max_seq_length 65536` 全同 → `compute_config_hash` 与种子后缀相同 → 解析到同一 `<hash>-6068a350-rowaligned` 目录，replay 数据由 `--extra_numpy_dirs` 并入（作业 cache 目录内是指向冻结缓存的符号链接）。

**第三步：回答「为什么默认镜像跑不了 a4b」。** 对照 [Dockerfile:L88-L112](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/Dockerfile#L88-L112) 与 [open_instruct/olmo_core_utils.py:L575-L587](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/open_instruct/olmo_core_utils.py#L575-L587) 写三句话答案：MoE v2 的 token permutation 依赖 TE；默认镜像不装 TE（OLMo-core 把算子置 None）；在默认镜像上启动会在 `setup_model` 判定 `OLMoDDPModel` 后立即抛出带修复指引的 RuntimeError。正确命令：配方式 `uv run python scripts/train/sft.py --recipe a4b`；自建镜像式 `./scripts/train/build_image_and_launch.sh --cuda-version 13 --moe SCRIPT`。

**第四步：a4b 相对 c12r 的五个关键差异表。** 每项一句话动机（参考答案）：

| # | 差异 | 动机（一句话） |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 镜像 `01M5KX…` → `01M7VC…` | MoE v2 需要 transformer-engine 与镜像内的 a4B 模型配置，main 镜像两者皆无 |
| 2 | 基座 dense B1 step20000 → A4B hero 4T decay 端点 step162974 | 实验要隔离的变量就是基座本身 |
| 3 | 峰值 LR 2e-4 → 7.3e-5 | 按两基座预训练 LR 之比（4.04e-4 / 1.1e-3）等比缩放，避免对低 LR 收敛基座扰动过大 |
| 4 | 新增 EP8 + fused_linear CE + expandable_segments + flash_2/整块重计算组合 | MoE 专家分片放得下、65k 词表 logits 不物化、防碎片 OOM、绕开 FA4 在 SM100 上拒绝 head_dim 256 |
| 5 | timeout 14h→72h、min_runtime 45m→2h15m | 步速慢约四倍（约 7.4 s/step 外推），首个临时 checkpoint 约第 2 小时，预算随之放大 |

**第五步（可选）：跑不变量测试。** `uv run pytest tests/test_sft_recipes.py -v`，把四个用例与你流程图里的节点对应起来。

## 6. 本讲小结

- **配方 = 固化的一次运行**：`RECIPES` 字典固定镜像、基座、数据、超参、集群与预算；训练代码来自镜像而非 checkout，重复执行同名命令从无时间戳输出目录的最新 checkpoint 断点续跑。
- **启动器只做展开**：`main` 把配方翻译成 mason 命令（`--image/--cluster/--num_nodes/--env/--min_runtime/--timeout` + `--` 后的 torchrun 训练命令），`--dry_run` 让这一切无需 Beaker 即可检查。
- **a4b = c12r 的换基座臂**：数据、缓存（`bf82a8fab8-6068a350-rowaligned`）、种子、18,410 步全同；增量是 TE 镜像、A4B 基座、7.3e-5 的缩放 LR、EP8/fused_linear/expandable_segments 的显存工程与放大的超时预算；速度数字是外推估计，固定镜像仅过 40 步冒烟，尚无完整运行。

- **不变量测试锁住展开正确性**：`tests/test_sft_recipes.py` 用 dry_run 输出断言每个配方的 mason 展开（镜像/节点/集群/步数/种子/缓存/逐项 env/torchrun 前缀），并用 a4b 专属用例锁住「数据侧零差异 + TE 镜像」这两条实验前提。

## 7. 下一步学习建议

- **往下钻训练入口**：回到 u7-l1 的 `open_instruct/olmo_core_finetune.py`，重点读 `--expert_parallel_degree` 如何进入 `TransformerDataParallelConfig`（本讲 [L648-L668](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/open_instruct/olmo_core_finetune.py#L648-L668) 之后的并行配置组装），理解 EP8 与 HSDP 的关系。

# u7-l5 SFT 配方启动器：scripts/train/sft.py、A4B 配方与 CUDA 13 MoE 镜像

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 理解「配方（recipe）」的运行模型：一条 `uv run python scripts/train/sft.py --recipe <名字>` 命令如何展开成一个完整的 Beaker 任务，为什么它**不需要先构建镜像、不需要先提交代码**。
2. 读懂 `RECIPES` 字典里 c12r 与 a4b 两个配方的每一类字段，并能说出两者在镜像、基座、学习率、并行与显存、超时预算上的关键差异及其动机。
3. 解释 A4B（MoE v2 / `OLMoDDPModel`）训练为什么必须换镜像：transformer-engine 依赖、cuda13-moe 镜像变体如何构建、以及缺 TE 时启动期的报错防线。
4. 会用 `--dry_run` 与 `tests/test_sft_recipes.py` 验证配方的展开不变量。

本讲是「从零跑通」与「读懂入口」之后的** launch 层**：u7-l1 精读了训练入口 `open_instruct/olmo_core_finetune.py`，本讲讲的是站在它上面、把一整次已知可跑的训练固化成一条命令的启动器。

## 2. 前置知识

- **Beaker 与 mason.py**（u1-l4、u9-l1）：Beaker 是 Ai2 的 GPU 任务平台；`mason.py` 把一条训练命令包装成 Beaker 任务（注入镜像、环境变量、数据挂载）。`--pure_docker_mode` 表示直接用镜像自带环境运行；`--min_runtime` 设置 Beaker 的 `minRuntime`（受保护最短运行时，至少 5 分钟且带单位）；`--auto_resume` 设置 `autoResume`（被抢占后自动重排）。
- **MoE v2 / OLMoDDPModel**（u1-l2、u1-l4）：Olmo 3.5 Small（A4B）是混合专家模型，其 MoE 层的 token permutation（专家分发前的重排）调用 transformer-engine（TE）的算子；它拒绝 FSDP，走 OLMo-core 的 DDP 训练模块。
- **numpy 预编码缓存**（u3-l2、u7-l1）：OLMo-core 路线的 SFT 不在训练时现分词，而是先跑一个 CPU 分词作业，把 token 流写成可 mmap 的 numpy 文件；训练启动时若缓存目录不命中会直接硬失败。
- **transformer-engine（TE）**：NVIDIA 的训练库，这里只用到它的 `pytorch.permutation` 一组算子。它是**预编译二进制 + 从源码编译的 torch 绑定**的混合体，因此对镜像里 torch/cuBLAS 的版本非常敏感——这是本讲镜像变体一节的伏笔。
- **配方（recipe）**：本讲的核心概念——把一次已知良好的训练运行（基座、数据、超参、镜像、集群、超时）固化成一个字典，让「换个基座重跑」「断点续跑」都退化成一条命令加一两个覆盖参数。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| [tests/test_sft_recipes.py](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/tests/test_sft_recipes.py) | 用 `--dry_run` 断言每个配方展开不变量的测试 |
| [Dockerfile](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/Dockerfile) | cuda12 / cuda13 / cuda13-moe 三种训练镜像的构建定义 |

| [scripts/test/run_gpu_pytest.sh](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/scripts/test/run_gpu_pytest.sh) | GPU 测试脚本：按镜像名把 `-cuda13`/`-cuda13-moe` 路由到 CUDA 13 集群 holmes |
